programmes.d: The mother of two infamous outlaw sons, against great odds, tries to steer her youngest boy into an honest life.
A buffalo hunter comes to Dodge not only to sell his hides, but also to pick a fight.
Earl Holliman plays Boone Shadler, a convict who escapes from prison after masquerading as a priest. In other guest roles, Denver Pyle plays a dying old man and Diana Hyland appears as a saloon girl.
A woman scorned by townsfolk because her husband was acquitted of murder is befriended by the same people when her husband dies
Matt's double is murdered, leaving the residents of Dodge very confused.
Miss Kitty has to keep a boy away from his father whom the boy doesn't know is a fugitive killer.

Ron Moody, an Oscar nominee for his role in the movie Oliver, guest stars as a man torn between keeping his own self-respect and the friendship of a young boy and keeping his drunken promise to help two hired gunmen.
A man returns to Dodge to kill his brother as revenge for marrying his fiancée.
People suspect ex-gunfighter Jake MacGraw has ulterior motives when he gets a job as a piano player in the Long Branch Saloon.
The head of a buffalo-hunting party is unwilling to tell Matt what he knows about the murders of two of his skinners.
Kitty Russell and a young gunsmith from the East are abducted from a stagecoach on the trail to Dodge City.
Matt frees a white woman and her daughter from slavery by the Indians.
Festus is arrested and forced to stand trial as a murderer named Frank Eaton who looks just like the Dodge City deputy.
A rancher's son lets his older brother bear all the blame when they return home after serving a prison sentence for cattle rustling.
A crafty journalist bets that a greenhorn can pose as a hardened gunman in Dodge City for two weeks and not get killed.
When Chester's mail-order bride arrives, neither she nor Chester are what the other are expecting.
Marshal Dillon finds out about the fury of a woman scorned when he spurns the advances of an outlaw's girlfriend.
A girl from the east comes to Dodge to experience life in the west.
A pair of landgrabbers kill a homesteader's mule and hogs to get his ranch.
Doc is taken hostage by three con artists.
An attractive widow whose husband was killed in an Indian massacre comes to Dodge City to search for his body. (TV-PG)
A showdown is set to take place between the blacksmith and a gunman who used to court his wife.

Susan Oliver plays a spinster seeking a new life.
United States Marshal Matt Dillon of Dodge City must deal with fast trigger-happy outlaw Dan Grat (Paul Richards) who wants his way with the town.
Kitty gets shot trying to stop a fight in her saloon.
There is something familiar about Tom Cook's new bride.
A poverty-stricken woman and her son suffer the symptoms of scurvy and Doc Adams is almost helpless to do anything about it.
